_comment: MCP catalog budget (#780, epic #776). Measured from the real
tools/list, not from source. CI runs scripts/mcp_catalog_budget.py;
exceeding any budget below fails the check and prints which tools
moved. Raising a budget is a reviewed edit to this file — that is
the whole mechanism: growth stays possible and stops being silent.
Frozen at the surface of 2026-08-21 with no headroom on purpose:
epic #776 exists to shrink these numbers, and slack left 'for
convenience' is how the catalog reached this size.
baseline_tools is per-tool description+schema chars, used only to
print the diff on a breach.
Raised once on 2026-08-21 for hub_record_live_check (#813, feature
#811): 62 -> 63 tools, +516 description and +482 schema chars, and
the model-visible total grows by those plus one more copy of the
1599-char server instruction. The trade is deliberate and belongs in
the review, not in a silent edit: three defects that day (#801,
#802, #803) passed review and green CI and were caught only by a run
against production, and the hub had nowhere to record that such a run
happened. Epic #776 still owns shrinking these numbers; this raise is
the exception it will have to absorb, not permission for the next one.
